theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by
  intro u i
  have hl := UpdateStatesLength u
  have hl' := InitStatesLength i
  have hd : ks.Disjoint ks' := by
    intro x hx hy
    have h := UpdateStatesDefined u x hx
    rw [InitStatesNotDefined i x hy] at h
    cases h
  refine ⟨_, rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact updatedStatesInit hl' (UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' (InitStatesNotDefined i) u) (InitStatesNodup i)
  · rw [InitStatesUpdated i, UpdateStatesUpdated u]
    unfold updatedStates
    rw [updatedStatesComm]
    · exact updatedStatesUpdate hl (updatedStatesDefMonotone (UpdateStatesDefined' u))
    · simp only [List.unzip_zip hl, List.unzip_zip hl']
      exact hd

lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  funext x₀
  by_contra hx₀
  have hc : Continuous (fun x => ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ) :=
    Continuous.inner' f (fun _ => f x₀) hf continuous_const
  have hp : 0 < ⟪f x₀, f x₀⟫_ℝ :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne real_inner_self_nonneg' (Ne.symm (inner_self_eq_zero'.not.mpr hx₀))
  obtain ⟨φ, hφs, hφc, hφd, hφn, hφ1⟩ :=
    exists_contDiff_tsupport_subset (hc.continuousAt.eventually_const_lt hp)
  have hn : 0 ≤ (fun x => φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ) := by
    intro x
    by_cases hx : φ x = 0
    · simp [hx]
    · exact mul_nonneg (Set.range_subset_iff.mp hφn x).1
        (hφs (subset_tsupport φ (Function.mem_support.mpr hx))).le
  have hz : φ x₀ * ⟪f x₀, f x₀⟫_ℝ ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hφ1, one_mul]
    exact hp.ne'
  have hi := (hφd.continuous.mul hc).integral_pos_of_hasCompactSupport_nonneg_nonzero
    hφc.mul_right hn hz (μ := μ)
  have hzero := hg _ (IsTestFunction.smul_right ⟨hφd, hφc⟩ contDiff_const (g := fun _ => f x₀))
  have he : ∫ x, φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0 := by
    simpa only [inner_smul_right'] using hzero
  exact hi.ne' he

theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  refine ⟨_, ChoiceBisim.choice h, ?_⟩
  intro s₁ s₂ hr μ
  cases hr with
  | choice h =>
    constructor <;> intro s t <;> cases t
    case' left.choiceR | right.choiceR => exact ⟨s, .choiceR ‹_›, .bisim (.refl s)⟩
    all_goals
      rename_i t
      apply Exists.imp fun _ => .imp .choiceL .bisim
    exacts [h.follow_fst t, h.follow_snd t]
  | bisim h =>
    constructor <;> intro s t
    all_goals apply Exists.imp fun _ => .imp id .bisim
    exacts [h.follow_fst t, h.follow_snd t]

  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by

  repeat constructor
  · apply updatedStatesInit (InitStatesLength i)
    · exact UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' (InitStatesNotDefined i) u

lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have der' := der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  all_goals have lc := der'.wf.2.1
  case var => grind
  case abs | tabs => left; constructor; assumption
  case sub d _ ih => exact ih rfl d
  case' app l r il ir =>
    rcases il rfl l with vl | ⟨_, rl⟩
    case' inl =>
      rcases ir rfl r with vr | ⟨_, rr⟩
      case' inl => obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs vl
    all_goals cases lc
  case' tapp d _ ih =>
    rcases ih rfl d with v | ⟨_, r⟩
    case' inl => obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := d.canonical_form_tabs v
    all_goals cases lc
  case' let' d _ ih _ =>
    obtain ⟨_, b⟩ := body_let.mp lc
    rcases ih rfl d with v | ⟨_, r⟩
  case' inl d _ ih | inr d _ ih =>
    rcases ih rfl d with v | ⟨_, r⟩
  case' case d _ _ ih _ _ =>
    obtain ⟨_, b₂, b₃⟩ := body_case.mp lc
    rcases ih rfl d with v | ⟨_, r⟩
    case' inl =>
      obtain ⟨_, h | h⟩ := d.canonical_form_sum v <;> subst h <;> cases v
  all_goals solve_by_elim (maxDepth := 8) [Or.inl, Or.inr, Exists.intro, Value.inl, Value.inr,
    Red.appₗ, Red.appᵣ, Red.abs, Red.tapp, Red.tabs, Red.let_bind, Red.let_body,
    Red.inl, Red.inr, Red.case, Red.case_inl, Red.case_inr]
